# #11: an approved brief whose Files list is src/twiddle/stations/catalog/*.toml, claimed, PR open.
# Three wrong heads pushed in turn. Each one's tests pass and the fake Codex approves it (both recorded),
# and still the gate and merge refuse it. main never moves:
# 1. a file a quick change may never touch (a speaker writer)
sdlc.py quick-gate 12
refused: the diff touches a path a quick change may not (src/twiddle/play.py): `escalate-to-full 11`
refused: the diff changes files outside the brief's `## Files` list (src/twiddle/play.py): `escalate-to-full 11`
(exit 1)
sdlc.py merge 12 --dry-run
error: the diff touches a path a quick change may not (src/twiddle/play.py): `escalate-to-full 11`; the diff changes
files outside the brief's `## Files` list (src/twiddle/play.py): `escalate-to-full 11`
(exit 1)
# 2. six files: more than the lane's five
sdlc.py quick-gate 12
refused: the diff changes 6 files, more than the quick lane's 5: `escalate-to-full 11`
(exit 1)
# 3. a file the brief doesn't list
sdlc.py quick-gate 12
refused: the diff changes files outside the brief's `## Files` list (src/twiddle/stations/model.py): `escalate-to-full
(exit 1)
# 4. a stale brief. A good head, tested and approved by Codex against the brief as approved:
sdlc.py quick-gate 12
ok
# the tool won't revise a brief while its change is being built:
sdlc.py transition 11 prd-review --kind prd --lane quick --body-file <scratch>/scratch/brief.md
error: #11 is a quick change being built, so its brief is frozen: `uv run python tools/sdlc.py escalate-to-full 11` is
the way to change course
(exit 1)
# so a person edits it by hand on the issue (rev 2) and the poster approves that. The approval
# Codex gave against rev 1 no longer counts:
sdlc.py quick-gate 12
refused: Codex's approval of b2648d3d67d9 was recorded against brief 901, not the approved brief 913: a Codex round
against the approved brief comes first
(exit 1)
sdlc.py merge 12
error: Codex's approval of b2648d3d67d9 was recorded against brief 901, not the approved brief 913: a Codex round
against the approved brief comes first
(exit 1)
# main is where it started ('main'), with no station on it
